cases.quoteCharacterization: Contemporaneous recent/end price, corroborated by dated exchange newspaper table; not independently certified official exchange close
cases.timing: Quote is entry-day close/recent sale, not known at the earlier open cutoff. This inverse diagnostic is separate from original intrinsic freeze.

growthPremiumDiagnostic.definition: Add x percentage points to each of first five annual growth rates, taper premium linearly in years6–9 to zero in year10; retain margins, investment productivity, taxes, WACC, terminal g and ROIC. This changes funded investment, not just revenue.

waccShiftDiagnostic.definition: Parallel shift to all explicit WACC rates and terminal WACC; all operating forecasts and terminal ROIC unchanged. Non-unique alternative inverse problem, not an observed historical discount rate.

cases.interpretation: A solved parameter identifies one combination that reproduces the quote under all other fixed assumptions. It does not reveal unique market beliefs, establish fair value, or justify changing the frozen forecast.
